examples.en: The author sent her manuscript to the publisher last week.
examples.zh: 作者上週把她的原稿寄給了出版社。

examples.en: The museum keeps an ancient manuscript in a glass case.
examples.zh: 博物館把一份古老的手抄本收藏在玻璃櫃裡。

examples.en: He spent months revising the manuscript of his first novel.
examples.zh: 他花了好幾個月修改他第一部小說的手稿。

examples.en: A large maple stands in front of our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校前面有一棵高大的楓樹。

examples.en: The leaves of the maple turn red in autumn.
examples.zh: 楓樹的葉子在秋天會變紅。

examples.en: They bought a dining table made of maple.
examples.zh: 他們買了一張楓木做的餐桌。

examples.en: A few scratches mar the surface of the table.
examples.zh: 幾道刮痕破壞了桌面的外觀。

examples.en: Heavy rain marred our weekend trip to the lake.
examples.zh: 大雨破壞了我們週末到湖邊的旅行。

examples.en: Please do not mar the wall with stickers.
examples.zh: 請不要用貼紙破壞牆面外觀。

examples.en: The new rule made only a marginal difference in sales.
examples.zh: 這項新規定對銷售額只造成微小的差異。

examples.en: She wrote a few marginal notes beside the text.
examples.zh: 她在文章旁邊的空白處寫了幾則註記。

examples.en: The company reported a marginal increase in profit this year.
examples.zh: 這家公司今年的獲利有小幅成長。

examples.en: My brother practices martial arts every weekend.
examples.zh: 我哥哥每個週末都練武術。

examples.en: The country was placed under martial law after the crisis.
examples.zh: 危機發生後，這個國家實施了戒嚴。

examples.en: The band played martial music as the soldiers marched past.
examples.zh: 樂隊在士兵列隊走過時演奏軍樂。

examples.en: Visitors marvel at the beauty of the old temple.
examples.zh: 遊客對這座古廟的美感到驚嘆。

examples.en: We marveled at how fast the little boy could read.
examples.zh: 我們對這個小男孩的閱讀速度之快感到驚奇。

examples.en: She marveled that the tiny seed could grow so tall.
examples.zh: 她驚嘆這麼小的種子竟然能長得那麼高。

examples.en: The bridge is a marvel of modern engineering.
examples.zh: 這座橋是現代工程的奇蹟。

examples.en: The little robot is a marvel to young children.
examples.zh: 這個小機器人對幼童來說是個神奇的東西。

examples.en: The Grand Canyon is one of the marvels of nature.
examples.zh: 大峽谷是大自然的奇景之一。

examples.en: Her mastery of English helped her get the job.
examples.zh: 她精通英文，這幫助她得到了這份工作。

examples.en: It takes years of practice to reach mastery of the violin.
examples.zh: 要精通小提琴需要多年的練習。

examples.en: The team showed total mastery of the ball in the final game.
examples.zh: 球隊在決賽中完全掌控了球。

examples.en: The teacher tried to mediate between the two students.
examples.zh: 老師試著居中調解那兩位學生。

examples.en: A neutral lawyer was asked to mediate the dispute.
examples.zh: 他們請了一位中立的律師來調解這項爭議。

examples.en: My mother often mediates when my brother and I argue.
examples.zh: 我哥哥和我吵架時，媽媽常常出面調解。

examples.en: We visited a medieval castle during our trip to Europe.
examples.zh: 我們到歐洲旅行時參觀了一座中世紀的城堡。

examples.en: The museum has a large collection of medieval art.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有大量中世紀的藝術收藏。

examples.en: She is writing a report on medieval food and clothing.
examples.zh: 她正在寫一篇關於中世紀飲食與服飾的報告。

examples.en: I meditate for ten minutes every morning before school.
examples.zh: 我每天早上上學前會冥想十分鐘。

examples.en: He went to the mountains to meditate in silence.
examples.zh: 他到山上去靜靜地冥想。

examples.en: She likes to meditate on her goals for the new year.
examples.zh: 她喜歡靜下心來思考新年的目標。

examples.en: Meditation helps me relax after a busy day.
examples.zh: 冥想能幫助我在忙碌的一天後放鬆。

examples.en: The class begins with five minutes of quiet meditation.
examples.zh: 這堂課以五分鐘的靜坐冥想開始。

examples.en: After long meditation, he finally made his decision.
examples.zh: 經過長時間的沉思後，他終於做了決定。

examples.en: A feeling of melancholy came over her on rainy days.
examples.zh: 下雨天時，她心中會湧起一股憂鬱。

examples.en: The old song filled him with melancholy.
examples.zh: 這首老歌讓他滿懷愁緒。

examples.en: There was a touch of melancholy in her smile.
examples.zh: 她的微笑裡帶著一絲憂愁。

examples.en: He sat by the window with a melancholy look.
examples.zh: 他帶著憂鬱的神情坐在窗邊。

examples.en: The melancholy music brought back old memories and made everyone quiet.
examples.zh: 憂傷的音樂勾起往日回憶，讓大家都安靜了下來。

examples.en: It was a melancholy ending to a long friendship.
examples.zh: 這是一段長久友誼令人憂傷的結局。

examples.en: A positive mentality will help you face difficult tests.
examples.zh: 正向的心態會幫助你面對困難的考試。

examples.en: The coach worked hard to change the team's mentality.
examples.zh: 教練努力改變球隊的心態。

examples.en: Some people have a winner's mentality from a young age.
examples.zh: 有些人從小就有贏家的思維。

examples.en: The store sells a wide range of sports merchandise.
examples.zh: 這家店販售各式各樣的運動商品。

examples.en: All merchandise on this shelf is half price.
examples.zh: 這個架上的所有商品都打五折。

examples.en: The merchandise arrived in perfect condition despite the long journey overseas.
examples.zh: 這批商品雖然經過漫長的海外運送，抵達時仍然完好無損。

examples.en: The shop merchandises its products with colorful displays.
examples.zh: 這家店用色彩繽紛的陳列來推銷商品。

examples.en: They plan to merchandise the new cartoon characters next month.
examples.zh: 他們打算下個月開始銷售新卡通角色的周邊商品。

examples.en: Many stores merchandise school supplies in September.
examples.zh: 許多商店在九月會主打文具用品的銷售。

examples.en: The little girl drew a mermaid with long red hair.
examples.zh: 小女孩畫了一隻有著紅色長髮的美人魚。

examples.en: In the story, a mermaid falls in love with a prince.
examples.zh: 故事中，一隻美人魚愛上了一位王子。

examples.en: We saw a mermaid show at the aquarium.
examples.zh: 我們在水族館看了一場美人魚表演。

examples.en: Many migrants move to the city to find work.
examples.zh: 許多移居工作者搬到城市找工作。

examples.en: The school offers free language classes for recently arrived migrants.
examples.zh: 這所學校為新到的移居者提供免費語言課程。

examples.en: Migrants often miss the food from their hometowns.
examples.zh: 移居外地的人常常想念家鄉的食物。

examples.en: The farm hires migrant workers during the harvest season.
examples.zh: 農場在收成季節會僱用流動的移工。

examples.en: Migrant birds fly south for the winter.
examples.zh: 候鳥會飛往南方過冬。

examples.en: A migrant family moved into the house next door.
examples.zh: 一戶移居的家庭搬進了隔壁的房子。

examples.en: My little sister likes to mimic our mother's voice.
examples.zh: 我妹妹喜歡模仿媽媽的聲音。

examples.en: Parrots can mimic human speech very well.
examples.zh: 鸚鵡能把人說的話模仿得很像。

examples.en: The comedian mimics famous people to make the audience laugh.
examples.zh: 這位喜劇演員模仿名人來逗觀眾笑。

examples.en: He is a talented mimic who can copy any accent.
examples.zh: 他是個很有天分的模仿者，能學任何口音。

examples.en: The class clown is a great mimic.
examples.zh: 班上的開心果很會模仿別人。

examples.en: This insect is a mimic of a green leaf.
examples.zh: 這種昆蟲會擬態成一片綠葉。

examples.en: Guests mingled with each other before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前，賓客們彼此交談往來。

examples.en: I am too shy to mingle with strangers at parties.
examples.zh: 我太害羞了，不敢在派對上與陌生人交際。

examples.en: The smell of coffee mingled with the smell of fresh bread.
examples.zh: 咖啡的香味與新鮮麵包的香味混在一起。

examples.en: The patient made a miraculous recovery after the surgery.
examples.zh: 病人在手術後奇蹟般地康復了。

examples.en: It was miraculous that nobody was hurt in the accident.
examples.zh: 那場事故中竟然沒有人受傷，真是奇蹟。

examples.en: The child's miraculous escape from the flooded house surprised the rescuers.
examples.zh: 那個孩子奇蹟般地從淹水的房屋脫困，讓救難人員感到驚訝。

examples.en: The mischievous boy hid his sister's shoes.
examples.zh: 那個調皮的男孩把他姊姊的鞋子藏了起來。

examples.en: Our mischievous puppy chews everything it finds.
examples.zh: 我們淘氣的小狗找到什麼就咬什麼。

examples.en: She gave us a mischievous smile before telling the joke.
examples.zh: 她在說笑話前對我們露出了淘氣的微笑。

examples.en: The mayor mobilized volunteers to clean up the park.
examples.zh: 市長動員志工來清理公園。

examples.en: The school mobilized all its teachers to help the new students.
examples.zh: 學校動員所有老師來幫助新生。

examples.en: It took a few hours to mobilize the rescue team.
examples.zh: 集結救難隊花了幾個小時。

examples.en: The modernization of the city's transport system took ten years.
examples.zh: 這座城市交通系統的現代化花了十年。

examples.en: Rapid modernization has changed the way people live.
examples.zh: 快速的現代化改變了人們的生活方式。

examples.en: The factory needs modernization to stay competitive.
examples.zh: 這家工廠需要現代化才能維持競爭力。

examples.en: The school plans to modernize its computer rooms.
examples.zh: 學校打算讓電腦教室更現代化。

examples.en: The owner modernized the old kitchen last summer.
examples.zh: 老闆去年夏天把舊廚房改造得更現代。

examples.en: The government wants to modernize the railway system.
examples.zh: 政府想要使鐵路系統現代化。

examples.en: The team gained momentum after winning three games in a row.
examples.zh: 球隊連贏三場後氣勢大增。

examples.en: The project lost momentum when the manager left.
examples.zh: 經理離開後，這項專案失去了推動力。

examples.en: At the same speed, a heavy truck has more momentum than a small car.
examples.zh: 在速度相同時，重型卡車的動量比小汽車大。

examples.en: The monarch waved to the crowd from the balcony.
examples.zh: 君主從陽台向群眾揮手。

examples.en: Britain is ruled by a monarch and a parliament.
examples.zh: 英國由君主與國會共同治理。

examples.en: The young monarch took the throne at the age of eighteen.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的君主十八歲就登上了王位。

examples.en: The bank controls the country's monetary policy.
examples.zh: 這家銀行掌管國家的貨幣政策。

examples.en: The painting has great monetary value because it is extremely rare.
examples.zh: 這幅畫因為極為稀有，所以有很高的金錢價值。

examples.en: The company offered monetary rewards for good ideas.
examples.zh: 公司提供金錢獎勵給好點子。

examples.en: She wanted to escape the monotony of office work.
examples.zh: 她想擺脫辦公室工作的單調。

examples.en: Music helps break the monotony of a long drive.
examples.zh: 音樂有助於打破長途開車的單調。

examples.en: The monotony of the lesson made the students sleepy.
examples.zh: 這堂課的單調讓學生昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: A monstrous wave rose above the small boat.
examples.zh: 一個巨大的浪頭在小船上方升起。

examples.en: The movie shows a monstrous creature living under the sea.
examples.zh: 這部電影描寫一隻住在海底的可怕生物。

examples.en: The monstrous traffic jam lasted for three hours.
examples.zh: 那場嚴重的塞車持續了三個小時。

senses.zh: 情緒多變的；心情不好的

examples.en: My sister gets moody when she doesn't sleep well.
examples.zh: 我姊姊睡不好時就會情緒不穩。

examples.en: He was moody all morning and barely spoke to anyone.
examples.zh: 他整個早上都心情不好，幾乎沒跟任何人說話。

examples.en: Teenagers can be moody because of the changes in their bodies.
examples.zh: 青少年可能因為身體的變化而情緒多變。

examples.en: The coach gave a speech to raise the team's morale.
examples.zh: 教練發表談話來提高球隊的士氣。

examples.en: Low morale at work made many people want to quit.
examples.zh: 工作上的士氣低落讓許多人想辭職。

examples.en: Good news from the boss improved morale in the office.
examples.zh: 老闆帶來的好消息提升了辦公室的士氣。

examples.en: She says motherhood has changed her view of life.
examples.zh: 她說為人母改變了她的人生觀。

examples.en: Many women balance work with motherhood by sharing childcare responsibilities with their partners.
examples.zh: 許多女性透過與伴侶分擔育兒責任，兼顧工作與母職。

examples.en: The poem celebrates the joy and hard work of motherhood.
examples.zh: 這首詩讚頌為人母的喜悅與辛勞。

examples.en: My motto is to do my best every day.
examples.zh: 我的座右銘是每天都盡力而為。

examples.en: The school motto is printed on every student's notebook.
examples.zh: 校訓印在每位學生的筆記本上。

examples.en: Could you tell us your family's motto and explain its meaning?
examples.zh: 你可以告訴我們你們家的家訓，並解釋它的意思嗎？

examples.en: The dog left a mound of dirt beside the hole.
examples.zh: 那隻狗在洞旁留下了一堆土。

examples.en: The pitcher stood on the mound and threw the ball.
examples.zh: 投手站在投手丘上投出球。

examples.en: There was a mound of laundry on the bed.
examples.zh: 床上有一大堆待洗的衣物。

examples.en: The whole town came together to mourn the teacher.
examples.zh: 全鎮的人聚在一起哀悼那位老師。

examples.en: She still mourns the loss of her pet cat.
examples.zh: 她仍為失去心愛的貓而哀傷。

examples.en: We mourn the end of summer vacation every year.
examples.zh: 我們每年都為暑假結束而感到惆悵。

examples.en: The violinist played a mournful tune in memory of her teacher.
examples.zh: 那位小提琴手演奏了一首哀傷的曲子，紀念她的老師。

examples.en: She gave a mournful look when she heard the sad news.
examples.zh: 她聽到壞消息時露出了悲傷的神情。

examples.en: A mournful cry came from the empty house.
examples.zh: 空屋裡傳來了淒涼的叫聲。

examples.en: He sat by the window and mused about his future.
examples.zh: 他坐在窗邊思索自己的未來。

examples.en: "I wonder where time goes," she mused.
examples.zh: 「我不知道時間都跑到哪去了。」她若有所思地說。

examples.en: We often muse on how life would be without phones.
examples.zh: 我們常常思考沒有手機的生活會是什麼樣子。

examples.en: The painter said the sea was his muse.
examples.zh: 畫家說大海是他的靈感來源。

examples.en: In Greek stories, a muse helps artists and poets.
examples.zh: 在希臘神話中，繆思女神會幫助藝術家與詩人。

examples.en: She was the muse behind his best songs.
examples.zh: 她是他最好的歌曲背後的靈感來源。

examples.en: My grandfather has a gray mustache that he trims every morning.
examples.zh: 我爺爺上唇留著灰白色的鬍子，每天早上都會修剪。

examples.en: He shaved off his mustache before the interview.
examples.zh: 他在面試前把鬍子刮掉了。

examples.en: The little boy drew a mustache on his face with a marker.
examples.zh: 小男孩用彩色筆在臉上畫了一撮鬍子。

examples.en: The students stayed mute when the teacher asked who broke the window.
examples.zh: 老師問是誰打破了窗戶，學生們都沉默不語。

examples.en: She stood mute with shock at the sight of the stage.
examples.zh: 她看到舞台時驚訝得說不出話來。

examples.en: The mute character uses sign language to communicate with her friends.
examples.zh: 這個無法說話的角色用手語與朋友溝通。

examples.en: Please mute your phone during the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會時請把你的手機調成靜音。

examples.en: He muted the television when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 電話響起時，他把電視調成靜音。

examples.en: You can mute the video by clicking this button.
examples.zh: 你可以按這個按鈕讓影片靜音。

examples.en: My mother always nags me to clean my room.
examples.zh: 我媽媽老是嘮叨要我整理房間。

examples.en: Stop nagging me about the homework; I'll do it later.
examples.zh: 別再為了作業一直唸我了；我等一下就會寫。

examples.en: A sore back kept nagging him all day.
examples.zh: 背痛整天一直困擾著他。

examples.en: My boss is not a nag, so I enjoy working for her.
examples.zh: 我的老闆不是個愛嘮叨的人，所以我很喜歡幫她工作。

examples.en: He called his sister a nag when she kept reminding him.
examples.zh: 他妹妹一直提醒他，他便說她是個嘮叨鬼。

examples.en: The old nag pulled the small cart slowly up the hill.
examples.zh: 那匹老馬慢慢地拉著小車爬上山坡。

examples.en: The teacher narrated the story to the class.
examples.zh: 老師對全班講述這個故事。

examples.en: A famous actor narrates the nature film.
examples.zh: 一位著名的演員為這部自然紀錄片擔任旁白。

examples.en: Grandpa likes to narrate his adventures during dinner.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡在晚餐時講述他的冒險故事。

examples.en: The narrator of the story is a young boy.
examples.zh: 這個故事的敘述者是個小男孩。

examples.en: The narrator's calm voice makes the film easy to follow.
examples.zh: 旁白平穩的聲音讓這部影片容易理解。

examples.en: We chose a narrator for the school play.
examples.zh: 我們為學校的戲劇挑選了一位旁白。

examples.en: Nationalism grew quickly in Europe during the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 十九世紀時，民族主義在歐洲迅速興起。

examples.en: The book explains how nationalism affects politics.
examples.zh: 這本書解釋了民族主義如何影響政治。

examples.en: Some people worry that strong nationalism can divide countries.
examples.zh: 有些人擔心強烈的民族主義會造成國家之間的分裂。

examples.en: Sailors used the stars to navigate across the ocean.
examples.zh: 水手利用星星在海上航行辨位。

examples.en: The new app is easy to navigate.
examples.zh: 這個新應用程式很容易操作。

examples.en: Teenagers must learn to navigate friendships and schoolwork.
examples.zh: 青少年必須學會應付友誼與課業。

examples.en: The car has a built-in navigation system.
examples.zh: 這輛車有內建的導航系統。

examples.en: Good navigation is important for ships at night.
examples.zh: 良好的航行定位對夜間的船隻很重要。

examples.en: The website's navigation is clear and simple.
examples.zh: 這個網站的導覽方式清楚又簡單。

examples.en: I am nearsighted, so I wear glasses to see the board.
examples.zh: 我近視，所以要戴眼鏡才看得到黑板。

examples.en: The committee rejected the nearsighted plan because it ignored future costs.
examples.zh: 委員會否決了這項短視的計畫，因為它忽略了未來的成本。

examples.en: She was too nearsighted to read the sign from the street.
examples.zh: 她近視得太嚴重，從街上看不清那塊招牌。

examples.en: He found a nickel on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 他在人行道上撿到一枚五分錢硬幣。

examples.en: A nickel is worth five cents in the United States.
examples.zh: 在美國，一枚五分硬幣的面額是五美分。

examples.en: Nickel is often used to make coins and batteries.
examples.zh: 鎳常被用來製造硬幣與電池。

examples.en: The cold air made her nostrils feel dry.
examples.zh: 冷空氣讓她覺得鼻孔乾澀。

examples.en: A horse's nostrils open wide when it runs.
examples.zh: 馬奔跑時鼻孔會張得很大。

examples.en: The doctor looked inside each nostril with a small light.
examples.zh: 醫師用小燈查看每個鼻孔內部。

senses.zh: 顯著的；值得注意的；著名的

examples.en: The museum is notable for its large collection of paintings.
examples.zh: 這間博物館以大量的畫作收藏而聞名。

examples.en: There was a notable improvement in his test scores.
examples.zh: 他的考試成績有顯著的進步。

examples.en: She is a notable member of the school's music club.
examples.zh: 她是學校音樂社中很出色的成員。

examples.en: Many local notables attended the opening of the library.
examples.zh: 許多地方名流出席了圖書館的開幕儀式。

examples.en: The party was full of notables from the film world.
examples.zh: 派對上有許多電影界的名人。

examples.en: The mayor invited a few notables to the dinner.
examples.zh: 市長邀請了幾位顯要人物參加晚宴。

examples.en: The street is notorious for its heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 這條街以嚴重塞車而惡名昭彰。

examples.en: He is notorious for arriving late to meetings.
examples.zh: 他因為開會老是遲到而出了名。

examples.en: The restaurant became notorious for its slow service.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳因服務緩慢而聲名狼藉。

examples.en: As a novice, I need a lot of help with this software.
examples.zh: 身為新手，我在使用這套軟體時需要很多協助。

examples.en: The class is designed for novices who have never played the piano.
examples.zh: 這堂課是為從沒彈過鋼琴的初學者設計的。

examples.en: Even a novice can follow these simple steps.
examples.zh: 就算是新手也能照著這些簡單的步驟做。
